title: Create and Integrate Your Custom Model
text: Important Note: writing RTMB function, must use RTMB compatible math functions (e.g., RTMB::dnorm, RTMB::rowSums) rather standard base R variants ensure automatic differentiation works properly.
code: # Example custom model template for an RTMB NLL function nll_func_custom <- function(pars) {   # Unpack data_list and parameters into the function environment   RTMB::getAll(data_list, pars)      # Perform matrix multiplication (e.g., sparse design matrix %*% parameters)   v <- X %*% betas      # Extract utility of chosen alternatives   v_chosen <- v[chosen_lin_idx]      # Reshape utility vector for log-sum-exp calculations   dim(v) <- c(J_alts, N_obs)      # Calculate log-sum-exp (consider robust numeric scaling if necessary)   log_sum_exp <- log(RTMB::colSums(exp(v)))      # Calculate the negative log-likelihood   nll <- -sum(v_chosen - log_sum_exp)      return(nll) }
